|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">任意の星系カードに配備する。相手の宇宙船１隻を対象に選ぶ。対象は戦闘力＝０、没収＝０となる。対象がこのカードと同じ場所に移動したなら、相手は運命数を引く。運命数＞２なら、このカードはキャンセルされる。そうでなければ、次の移動フェイズにもう一度運命数を引く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-222o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">宇宙船は時として、戦闘でダメージを受け、修理と補給を受けるまで使用不能となる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Unexpected Damage.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any system. Target one opposing starship. The target's power and forfeit become 0. When it moves to the same location as this card, your opponent draws destiny. If it exceeds 2, cancel this card. Otherwise, your opponent draws destiny again during the next move phase.

'''Lore:''' Starships can take damage in combat and remain unusable until repaired and resupplied.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The opponent draws destiny when the target moves to the same location as this card. The English has the target draw destiny when it reaches the [[Utinni Effect]]. The Japanese cancels this card; the English cancels the [[Utinni Effect]].
